annotations.note: PRIMARY layer and the high-value under-exemplified type. The work is a parallel edition: for every manuscript, a transcription block (source-language, masked body) is paired with a 'trans.' English-translation block (type=translation, mask=true). The attribution line is the strong recurring anchor. Within each translation block the text is subdivided by 'Frg. N' / 'Col. N' headings and numbered lines carrying editorial conventions ([ ] reconstructions, vacat = blank). I did NOT promote 'Frg.' to a chapter level: 'Frg.' occurs 952× because every fragment heading prints TWICE per document (once in the transcription, once in the translation) and varies in granularity (Frg. / Frg. N Col. i), so it is internal sub-structure of the translation/transcription bodies, not a clean segmentable chapter container.
